Question: I saw a dream in which i am passing through a street with a very heavy bag on my shoulders then there are two houses and from the top of each house a girl from my school is inviting me to come.Then i say i have a very bad disease.then i go to one house and start to climb floors the girl comes down and says to her mother pls teach him on 3rd floor but i continue climbing towards the 5th floor with a heavy load.I say to the girl dont ask your mother to come down to teach me tuition i will go up. Answer ID: 9720 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2587/2069=H/1429) The dream is a warning that looking at girls and women as well as intermingling with them is poisonous, so one must be extremely careful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
